julia (acme): Hey, streaming is hanging for us. We call .stream() and generator yields a few tokens then stops forever. Happens ~30% of requests. Using python-sdk 0.9.1.
kevin.sdk: Sorry — can you paste the minimal repro and any logs? Is this only with long responses or short ones too?
julia (acme): Short responses too. Repro steps: 1) python3 main.py (attached) 2) invoke chat.stream with system+prompt 3) generator yields first chunk then never yields again. No exception.
julia (acme): Log snippet: 
```\nINFO: starting stream
RECV: b'data: {"id":"tok","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel"}}] }\n\n'
RECV: b'data: {"id":"tok","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"lo"}}] }\n\n'
# then nothing, connection still open
```
julia (acme): Notice the split "Hel" / "lo" across two events.
kevin.sdk: That looks like partial-token boundary across SSE events. Which HTTP client are you using? aiohttp/requests/httpx?
julia (acme): httpx 0.24.0 (async). running behind an Nginx LB.
ellie.dev: Also any proxy or ingress that might coalesce chunk frames? Nginx sometimes has chunked buffering.
julia (acme): We tried bypassing LB (direct to node) and still saw it but less frequently. Also we saw 401s intermittently right before hang. Token refresh in our app uses background coroutine.
ops-sam: Do you do concurrent refresh + streaming request with same API key? We had a bug where auth refresh replaced headers mid-stream and server returned a short "event: auth" that closed stream; client then paused awaiting newline.
julia (acme): Hmm we do refresh and then retry new requests but shouldn't touch in-flight stream. Could be a race in our wrapper.
kevin.sdk: Can you try two quick experiments: 1) upgrade python-sdk to 0.10.3 which has SSE parsing fixes for split UTF-8 boundaries and keepalive handling, 2) set stream_keepalive=False in client config to disable server heartbeat processing and see if it unblocks?
julia (acme): Will try. Any quick patch if we can't upgrade?
ellie.dev: As workaround, ensure the HTTP client reads raw bytes and concatenates until it sees a double new-line delimiter between events before handing to SSE parser. Our 0.9.x parser processed per-chunk which could cut a JSON token in half.
julia (acme): Tried local patch to buffer until b"\n\n" and that prevented hangs locally. But in prod there were still occasional 502 then hang.
ops-sam: 502s likely from LB timing out during auth refresh. Also check if your app swaps env var for API_KEY — that may trigger a short 401 from auth middleware. If server sends an event like `event: auth\ndata: {"status":"refresh"}\n\n` and then closes, older SDK versions didn't surface the "closed with last event incomplete" error and generator stayed sleeping.
julia (acme): Ok makes sense. Upgrading now and enabling extra logs.
kevin.sdk: FYI in 0.10.3 we added: - accumulate bytes across chunks until SSE event delimiter, - defensive handling when connection closes mid-event (raise StreamDisconnected), - optional header `X-Stream-Auth-Version` to detect server/client mismatch.
julia (acme): Upgrade done. Re-running — initial tests look much better. No hangs in 50 runs. Still seeing one failure with 401 then immediate close; now SDK surfaces StreamDisconnected so we can retry.
julia (acme): Thanks. We'll roll to canary and monitor.
kevin.sdk: Great. If you see any reproduction steps that still hang, paste the raw tcpdump of the SSE stream (base64 ok) so we can correlate with server logs.
julia (acme): Will do. Also note we had billing header present sometimes causing server to close connection with code 200 + `data: [BILLING_ERROR]` then stop. That was confusing.
\ops-sam: That's a separate issue — billing bot emits event then server closes. We'll file SEV to product infra to treat billing events as non-terminal or send explicit `event: close` before shutdown.
support-bot: Ticket 20418 created linking customer acme + SDK incident.
julia (acme): Thanks all. Appreciate the quick help.
kevin.sdk: Follow-up: we'll backport the SSE parser fixes to 0.10.x branch and add a hotfix release if infra team confirms auth event behavior.
ellie.dev: Noted. Ops will check Nginx chunking configs (proxy_buffering, chunked_transfer_encoding) and LB timeouts.
julia (acme): Updated status: canary looks good. Will report back if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
